description.text: The fourth HeartGold & SoulSilver set, released on 3 November 2010 with 103 cards: 102 and a secret Alph Lithograph. Its LEGEND pairs are Dialga & Palkia and Darkrai & Cresselia, and its eight Pokémon Prime, among them Celebi, Gengar, Machamp, Mew and Magnezone, lean on the Lost Zone. Rescue Energy is new here. Its theme decks are Royal Guard, around Nidoking, and Verdant Frost, around Mamoswine. Its cards came from the Japanese Clash at the Summit and the mini-set Lost Link, whose Lost World waited for Call of Legends.
